
graphify token reduction benchmark
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Corpus:          2,950 words → ~3,933 tokens (naive)
  Graph:           59 nodes, 107 edges
  Avg query cost:  ~1,300 tokens
  Reduction:       3.0x fewer tokens per query
